name: dj-toolkit
description: A DJ's toolkit for Claude Code: /get-songs downloads any list in the best version from your own sources, /setlist-id tracklists DJ sets, /organize-library sorts and tags for rekordbox, /audio-quality catches fake lossless, /upgrade-to-extended swaps radio edits for extended mixes, /rekordbox-tools repoints playlists and triages BPMs, /dj-troubleshooting fixes common setup problems.
